xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4939: Agent MCP and bots (W-SCHED1): Scheduled messages and recurring schedules

plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-SCHED1): Scheduled messages and recurring schedules
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Agents and bots cannot manage a conversation's one-shot scheduled messages (PAN-4641) or recurring schedules (PAN-4640) through the Overdeck MCP server: there are no schedule tools, and the four /api/conversations/:name/schedules routes have no route-scope row, so they need admin and every scoped token is refused.
narratives.Proposal: Add four route-scope rows (GET read:conversations; POST, PATCH /:id, DELETE /:id tell) and a new src/lib/mcp/tools-schedule.ts with five audience 'any' tools over the existing routes: schedule_message, schedule_recurring, list_scheduled, update_scheduled, delete_scheduled (kind once|recurring picks the route). Register them in ALL_TOOLS between the write and approval tools, update the count tests, prove epic AC-10, and document the tools and scopes. No new route and no library change.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No clock-time one-shot message: schedule_message has no sendAt/time argument; the once kind stays usage-limit based.
- No cron presets (hourly/daily/weekly) in the tools and no import of @overdeck/contracts into src/lib/mcp/.
- No 'self' default for the conversation argument; it is always required.
- No new HTTP route, no change to src/dashboard/server/routes/*, no change to no-loss-matrix.ts.
- No change to the schedule doors (conversation-schedules.ts, conversation-scheduled-messages.ts) or the scheduled-message tick.
- No pan CLI change.
- No audience 'agent' schedule tools.
- No change to src/lib/mcp/tool.ts (helpers stay local to tools-schedule.ts).
- No instructions-block text (W-INJ4) and no epic-wide doc pass (W-DOC).

autoDecisions.summary: schedule_message takes only { conversation, message }; no time field.
autoDecisions.rationale: POST /api/conversations/:name/scheduled-messages reads only body.message and computes not_before from the usage limit (computeNotBefore, conversation-scheduled-messages.ts:58); a time field would need a new door, which the epic does not ask for.

autoDecisions.summary: conversation is a required argument on every schedule tool.
autoDecisions.rationale: McpToolContext carries no caller identity, and the epic gives these tools audience 'any' (bots use them), so a self default is not available.

autoDecisions.summary: schedule_recurring accepts cron only, no presets.
autoDecisions.rationale: presetToCron lives in @overdeck/contracts and src/lib/mcp/server.ts:15-16 limits the module's imports; cron examples in the description cover the presets.

autoDecisions.summary: list_scheduled returns { once, recurring, onceSupported, usageLimit } and fails as a whole when either GET fails.
autoDecisions.rationale: The epic names { once, recurring }; the extra two fields come free from the GET and tell the caller when a once message fires; an all-or-nothing answer prevents an agent from reading a failed half as empty.

autoDecisions.summary: update_scheduled/delete_scheduled refuse fields of the other kind; the tools do not duplicate route validation.
autoDecisions.rationale: A silently ignored field misleads the caller; route validators stay the one authority (epic NFR-1).

autoDecisions.summary: The positive-integer id helper is private to tools-schedule.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: tool.ts is shared with in-flight siblings W-SELF1, W-DEL1, W-APPR1; not editing it avoids merge conflicts.

autoDecisions.summary: ALL_TOOLS order is read, write, schedule, approve.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the approval tools last, matching the existing 'close the list' test intent.

autoDecisions.summary: Epic AC-10's 'token with tell' is tested as a read:conversations + tell token.
autoDecisions.rationale: scopeSatisfies does not let tell satisfy read:conversations, so a tell-only token cannot list; the bot and agent default scopes include both.

metadata.sizeJustification: Small: 12 files, one subsystem (the MCP tool module) plus one route-scope table and three doc pages; no new route.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4939.md WI-2 and decisions D-2, D-5, D-8, D-10. Create src/lib/mcp/tools-schedule.ts importing only from './tool.js' (never @overdeck/contracts or dashboard code). Add the module header from the PRD, private helpers conversationPath(name) = `/api/conversations/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, requiredId(args) (positive safe integer, error 'id must be a positive integer'), and CONVERSATION_PROPERTY. Add tool schedule_message (scope 'tell', audience 'any', schema {conversation, message} both required) whose description says it queues a message for a Claude Code conversation that Overdeck sends after the usage limit resets, or within a minute when not limited; at most 20 queued; /pan commands refused. It POSTs { message } to `${conversationPath(c)}/scheduled-messages` and returns routeResult. Export `SCHEDULE_TOOLS: readonly OverdeckTool[] = [scheduleMessage]`. Do NOT add it to ALL_TOOLS (item register-schedule-tools does that). Create tests/unit/lib/mcp/tools-schedule.test.ts using harness.ts connectClient(api, ['read:conversations','tell'], false, SCHEDULE_TOOLS) with the four tests named in the PRD. Never add a time argument (H-2).

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4939.md WI-3 and D-4, D-5. In src/lib/mcp/tools-schedule.ts add tool schedule_recurring (scope 'tell', audience 'any') with the PRD description (5-field cron with the example `0 9 * * 1-5`, runs at least 15 minutes apart, agent conversations and Session Vault copies refused, max 20). Schema: conversation, prompt, cron required strings; timeZone optional string described as 'An IANA time zone such as America/New_York; omit for the Overdeck machine's zone'; enabled optional boolean. Validate required strings with requiredString, timeZone with optionalString, enabled must be boolean when present (error 'enabled must be a boolean'). POST to `${conversationPath(c)}/schedules` a body of {prompt, cron} plus timeZone/enabled only when present. No preset argument and no presetToCron import. Append to SCHEDULE_TOOLS after schedule_message. Add the three tests named in the PRD to tests/unit/lib/mcp/tools-schedule.test.ts.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4939.md WI-4 and D-6. In src/lib/mcp/tools-schedule.ts add tool list_scheduled (scope 'read:conversations', audience 'any', schema {conversation} required). Send GET `${base}/scheduled-messages` and GET `${base}/schedules` with Promise.all; if the first is not isOk return routeErrorResult(first); else if the second is not isOk return routeErrorResult(second); else return jsonResult({ once: messages ?? [], recurring: schedules ?? [], onceSupported: supported ?? false, usageLimit: limit ?? null }) exactly as the PRD snippet. Never return a partial result. Append to SCHEDULE_TOOLS after schedule_recurring. Add the three tests named in the PRD to tests/unit/lib/mcp/tools-schedule.test.ts.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4939.md WI-5 and D-7, D-8. In src/lib/mcp/tools-schedule.ts add private requiredKind(args) (error 'kind must be once or recurring') and tool update_scheduled (scope 'tell', audience 'any'). Schema: conversation string, kind enum ['once','recurring'], id integer (all required); message, prompt, cron, timeZone strings and enabled boolean optional. kind once: if any of prompt/cron/timeZone/enabled is present return tool error 'prompt, cron, timeZone and enabled apply only to kind recurring'; message required; PATCH `${base}/scheduled-messages/${id}` with { message }. kind recurring: if message present return tool error 'message applies only to kind once'; copy present prompt/cron/timeZone (strings) and enabled (boolean, else 'enabled must be a boolean') into the body; PATCH `${base}/schedules/${id}` even when the body is empty (the route answers 400). Return routeResult. Append to SCHEDULE_TOOLS after list_scheduled. Add the five tests named in the PRD to tests/unit/lib/mcp/tools-schedule.test.ts.
